title: Fisher-Price Recalls Rock 'n Play Sleepers Due to Reports of Deaths
summary: Infant fatalities have occurred in Rock 'n Play Sleepers, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 4.7 million products.

title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Recalls Hunters' Tree Stands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The weld on the seats can break and cause the seat to fall from the tree, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: Specialized Recalls Bicycles with Steerer Tube Collars Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle's steerer tube collar can crack if exposed to corrosion resulting in sudden loss of steering control, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 63,000.

title: KTM and Husqvarna Motorcycles Recall Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle can become stuck in the open position, posing a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 780.

title: Marpac Recalls Sound Machines Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The sound machine's internal battery can leak and cause an electrical short, posing a burn hazard. Units: 5000.

title: Vivitar Recalls Hot/Cold Massage Balls Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The massage balls can leak or rupture during or after microwaving, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 60,000.

title: Matco Tools Wireless Chargers Recalled by Professional Tool Products Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The wireless chargers can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 4,800 (in addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Bicycles Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle's fork legs can break, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,900.

title: Amerex Group Recalls Infant Fur Jackets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The jacket's snaps can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,550.

title: John Deere Recalls Attachment Kits for Compact Utility Tractor Snow Blowers and Brooms Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The Attachment Kits are missing the product Operator's Manual which details proper attachment and use of the product, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,550.

title: Ocean Reef Recalls Neptune Space Integrated Diving Masks Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The diving mask regulator can cause restricted airflow, posing an injury hazard to divers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Spector & Co. Recalls Power Bank Chargers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The charger can overheat while recharging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4500 (in addition, about 2,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Kids II Recalls All Rocking Sleepers Due to Reports of Deaths
summary: Infant fatalities have occurred in the Rocking Sleepers, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: Approximately 694,000.

title: Ruggable Recalls Shag Rugs Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rug's shag cover fails to meet the federal flammability standard for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,200.

title: TriDerma Recalls Pain Relief Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 410.

title: Viessmann Recalls Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The boiler heat exchanger back plate can corrode and leak flue gases, allowing the boiler to emit excessive amounts of carbon monoxide, posing a CO poisoning hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,900 (in addition, about 1,400 were sold in Canada).

title: Bodum Recalls Stove Top Espresso Makers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The espresso maker's handle can ignite from the flame of a gas stove, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 500.

title: Flying Tiger Copenhagen Recalls Toy Train Carts Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The steam dome on the toy train's engine car can come loose, posing a choking hazard Units: About 2,200.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall-Alert)
summary: While operating the snowmobile the exhaust can flame from the muffler outlet, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,000 (In addition about 5,500 were sold in Canada).

title: RH Recalls Callum Canopy Beds Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bed's horizontal canopy rails can detach and fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,900 (In addition, about 135 were sold in Canada).

title: Target Recalls Wooden Toy Vehicles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wheels on the vehicles can detach, posing a choking hazard to children Units: About 495,000.

title: Tekno Products Recalls Tuff Smoke-Less Grills Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The grill can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 40,200.

title: Go Couture Recalls Children's Loungewear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's loungewear sets fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 120.

title: Heat Hero Recalls Portable Plug-in Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The heater can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 20,000 (In addition, about 49 units weres sold in Canada).

title: MTD Recalls Lawn Mowers Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's (Recall Alert)
summary: Sharp objects can pierce through the lawn mower's collecting bag during use and strike a user or bystander, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,000.

title: H&M Recalls Children's Bathrobes Due to Violation of Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's hooded bathrobes fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 980 (in addition, about 60 were sold in Canada).

title: Tween Brands Recalls Light Up Bed Canopies Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Justice (Recall Alert)
summary: The canopy lights can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 23,900 (in addition, about 950 were sold in Canada).
